summary: Verified the navbar visibility bug fix. At scrollY=0, the sticky navbar renders correctly over the dark hero: logo text 'Quantum Medical' is white (rgb(255,255,255)), all 8 nav item buttons are visible with color rgba(255,255,255,0.9), and the 'Partner With Us' CTA is visible (orange bg, white text). After scrolling (scrollY>=500), the header switches to white/blurred (bg-white/80, backdrop-blur-xl, border-b) and nav item text switches to dark #0B121C — confirmed both directions. Dropdown menus open on hover (Orthotics submenu appears with sub-links). Partner button opens the lead-modal. Mobile (390px) hamburger is visible against dark hero (white/10 bg + white icon) and drawer opens with all 8 nav items + Partner button. Regression: /products, /about, /contact-us, /lower-limb-orthotics all show the light navbar over their dark hero banners.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid for 'Mobility & Seating' nav button is rendered as 'nav-mobility---seating' (triple dash), not the expected 'nav-mobility-seating'. Root cause: the regex `.replace(/\s|&/g, '-')` on the label 'Mobility & Seating' converts each of the three chars ' ', '&', ' ' to '-'. Fix: use `.replace(/[\s&]+/g, '-')` (collapse runs) so the testid becomes 'nav-mobility-seating' as specified in the task.

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/components/Navbar.js line 64, change `.replace(/\s|&/g, '-')` to `.replace(/[\s&]+/g, '-')` so the 'Mobility & Seating' nav item exposes data-testid="nav-mobility-seating" (as required by the task spec and future E2E tests).
critical_code_review_comments: Navbar mobile menu button correctly adapts (white/10 bg + white icon) over dark hero and switches to bordered white/dark icon after scroll — good.
Scroll listener on `window.scrollY > 20` correctly toggles both header background and text colors; transition works both ways.
Testid derivation from labels is brittle: multi-character non-alphanumeric runs create multiple dashes. Use a normalization helper for testids.
Sheet drawer in mobile shows a small logo overlap during open animation (Quantum Medical text appears layered) — cosmetic only.

Only outstanding item is the 'nav-mobility---seating' testid naming (needs regex tweak). Do not re-run backend suite (rate limiter). Focus retesting on any newly reported issues.
rca of the issue: Original bug (invisible navbar at top over dark hero) is resolved: nav item text and logo are now conditionally set to text-white/90 and text-white when !scrolled. Verified via computed styles + screenshots. The scroll-driven color transition to text-[#0B121C] on white/blurred header also works as designed.
